_doc: The FlatBars editor token vocabulary — ADR-017's single source of truth, the
ONE contract shared by the three consumers it names: the engine `tokenize`
API (whose `kind` strings are the keys below), the `flatbars-lsp` semantic-
token legend (built from the `lsp` mappings), and the TextMate fallback
grammar (whose scopes must map back to a kind via `tmScopes`).
Each kind has a `role`: `tag` (a whole-tag span, painted by the meaning of its
head — what `highlightSpans` returns and the Lab/tutorials paint) or `interior`
(a literal/operator carved inside a tag — the richer axis only the editor layer
consumes). `lsp.type`/`lsp.modifiers` are the semantic-token legend entry.
`tmScopes` are the TextMate scopes the *stateless fallback* emits for this kind;
an empty list means the fallback deliberately GIVES UP on this kind (set
delimiters, dialect-error shapes, and — per ADR-017 — MaxBars infix operators),
leaving it plain for the LSP to correct rather than mis-colouring it.
Drift is gated: `check:highlight` pins what the engine emits, `check:tmgrammar`
pins that the grammar's scopes agree with the engine on the default-delimiter
corpus. Change a kind here and both gates plus the LSP legend move together.

set-delimiter.description: {{=A B=}} — a set-delimiter directive. STATEFUL: the fallback gives up; only the LSP colours it.

error.description: A structurally-valid tag the dialect disallows. DIALECT-DEPENDENT: the stateless fallback gives up; only the LSP knows the dialect.

string.description: A quoted string literal inside a tag.

number.description: A numeric literal inside a tag.

operator.description: An infix/prefix operator inside a tag. MaxBars-only and dialect-scoped: the stateless fallback gives up; only the LSP colours it.
